observation: Disc, globe and ring. Front: the disc wall widens as it rises, Sol's draft. The ring is tilted at the planet's obliquity and its low side is carried down to the disc as a solid web -- that is the deliberate support-free answer and it is the mirror of the other army's. Top: globe centred, ring crossing it. Iso: ring projects evenly all round; no floating part, no unsupported underside.
